title: single-amplicon-nf pipeline parameters
description: ONT single-amplicon pipeline: one barcode gene per sample -> one polished consensus sequence per sample, with QC.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with two columns: sample,fastq.
input.help_text: Each row maps a sample name to a fastq file or glob (e.g. `data/barcode17/*.fastq.gz`). A glob may match multiple part-files -- they're merged into one file per sample before filtering. Each sample should hold ONE amplicon (one barcode gene). Glob paths resolve relative to the launch directory, not the samplesheet's own location.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

primer_trimming.title: Primer trimming
primer_trimming.description: cutadapt primer trimming -- skipped unless both primers are set.

fwd_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only. Case-insensitive. Reads are searched in both orientations and flipped to the forward-primer orientation; reads where the primers are not found are discarded.

rev_primer.description: Reverse primer sequence, 5'->3' as ordered (not reverse-complemented).
rev_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only. Case-insensitive. Give it exactly as it appears on the order sheet; the pipeline reverse-complements it itself.

min_len.help_text: A barcode gene has no universal length, so set this for your amplicon -- a little under its expected length. Run with -entry READ_QC_ONLY first to see your read-length distribution.

max_len.description: Maximum read length. Leave empty for no upper cap.
max_len.help_text: Set a little over the expected amplicon length to drop concatemers and chimeric reads. Must be greater than min_len.

enable_read_stats.description: Summarize read length and Q-score before vs. after filtering.
enable_read_stats.help_text: Writes read_qc_summary.html, read_stats.tsv and read_length_qscore_hist.tsv to final_report/. Purely informational -- nothing downstream depends on it.

read_selection.title: Read selection
read_selection.description: How many reads feed the consensus, and the purity check on them.

downsample_reads.description: Randomly downsample each sample to this many reads for the consensus. 0 = use all reads.
downsample_reads.help_text: A consensus of a single amplicon stops improving long before thousands of reads. Sampling is random with a fixed seed, so a rerun gives the same consensus.

min_reads.description: Samples with fewer reads than this (after filtering and trimming) are not assembled.
min_reads.help_text: Such a sample is still listed in the summary, as FAIL / too_few_reads -- it does not stop the other samples.

enable_purity_check.description: Build the consensus from the dominant read cluster only, and report how dominant it is.
enable_purity_check.help_text: Clusters the reads (vsearch) and keeps the largest cluster, so a contaminated or mixed barcode yields its majority sequence instead of a blend. The share of reads in that cluster is reported as dominant_fraction; below min_dominant_frac the sample is flagged WARN. Catches unrelated/off-target contamination, not closely related variants.

cluster_id.description: vsearch identity threshold for the purity check.
cluster_id.help_text: Deliberately loose: it only has to tolerate raw ONT error between two reads of the same sequence. Too high (about 0.8 and over, with older/noisier basecalls) splits a clean sample into several clusters and makes it look mixed. Lower if clean samples report a low dominant_fraction.

enable_secondary_consensus.description: Also build a consensus from the second-largest read cluster when it is big enough.
enable_secondary_consensus.help_text: For a barcode that holds two real sequences (a mixed or contaminated sample), the main consensus is built from the larger group as before, and the other group gets a consensus of its own, with its own QC, listed in final_report/secondary_consensus.tsv and .fasta. Needs the purity check. Closely related variants fall in one cluster and are not separated.

min_secondary_frac.description: Smallest share of a sample's reads the second cluster needs to get its own consensus.
min_secondary_frac.help_text: Also needs at least min_reads reads. A scatter of small clusters (noisy reads) stays below this and is ignored.

consensus_polishing.title: Consensus polishing
consensus_polishing.description: spoa draft, racon polish, and optionally medaka.

enable_medaka.description: Polish the consensus with medaka (slower, more accurate).
enable_medaka.help_text: When off, the racon consensus is the final consensus.

medaka_model.help_text: Must match the pore, chemistry and basecaller model that produced the reads, or the polish can make the consensus worse.

qc_thresholds.title: QC thresholds
qc_thresholds.description: When a sample is flagged WARN or FAIL in the summary.

min_depth.description: Minimum mean read depth over the consensus (reads mapped back to it). Below this is FAIL.
min_depth.help_text: The same 30X default as wf-amplicon. Positions covered below this are reported as uneven coverage (WARN).

min_primary_frac.description: Minimum fraction of the sample's reads that must map to the consensus. Below this is FAIL.
min_primary_frac.help_text: Reads that don't map are contamination or off-target product.

min_dominant_frac.description: Minimum share of reads in the dominant cluster. Below this is WARN (mixed_reads).
min_dominant_frac.help_text: Only applies when the purity check is on.

container_images.title: Container images
container_images.description: Where each tool's container image is pulled from.

container_registry.help_text: The google_batch profile points this at the project's own Artifact Registry mirror (see scripts/mirror_images.sh); pass --container_registry quay.io to pull from upstream instead. The mirror keeps each image's upstream path, so only the host changes.

dockerhub_registry.description: Registry for the Docker Hub images (medaka, and ubuntu on Batch).
dockerhub_registry.help_text: Same idea as container_registry, for images that come from Docker Hub.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically left at their defaults.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

tracedir.description: Directory for the Nextflow timeline/report/trace files.
